name: Panama Digital Gateway / Corozal Regional Data Center
notes: Corozal, Panama City. DCD reports July 2023 launch of Tier III design-certified facility with 5,500 sqm, up to 650 equivalent racks and 3.5 MW scalable power; Sparkle official page describes the Corozal colocation data center; Uptime lists Panama Digital Gateway S.A. Corozal Regional Data Center certifications.

name: Tigo IDC Clayton
notes: Ciudad del Saber/Clayton, Panama City. Tigo official page lists Data Center Clayton among its certified Tier III data centers and notes 99.982% availability; Uptime lists IDC Clayton Phase 1 design, constructed facility, and operational sustainability certifications.

name: Tigo IDC 12/10
notes: 12 de Octubre / Av. 4C Norte, Panama City. Tigo official page lists Data Center 12/10; Uptime lists Cable Onda 12 de octubre with M&O Stamp of Approval; DataCenterMap gives the Panama City address.

name: UFINET Transistmica Data Center
notes: Avenida Simon Bolivar/Transistmica, Panama City. DCD reports Ufinet launched a Tier III Panama City data center in June 2023; Uptime lists Data Center Ufinet Transistmica certifications; TIA page lists ANSI/TIA-942-B design rating level 3 for Fase 1/Fase 2.

name: UFINET Victoria Plaza
notes: Victoria Plaza, Av. Ricardo Arango, Panama City. Aggregator listing describes UFINET Victoria Plaza as a Panama City data center designed under Uptime Tier III standards. Confirmed from aggregator only; no operator-specific page found during search.

name: C&W Panama IDC Balboa
notes: Balboa/Ancon, Panama City. DataCenterMap lists C&W Panama IDC Balboa at C. Ramon Levy, Edificio 0843; Cable & Wireless certification PDFs include IDC-Balboa in the scope for data center services.

name: Cirion PAN1
notes: Av. Arnulfo Arias Madrid, Panama City. DataCenterMap lists Cirion PAN1 and notes it was previously part of Lumen's Latin America operations; Cirion official site confirms it offers data centers across Latin America. Facility-level official page not found during search.

name: CSN-1 Costa del Este
notes: Costa del Este, Panama City. DataCenterMap lists the project under construction at 1.5 MW; DCD/BNamericas coverage says Telconet planned edge data centers including Costa del Este, Panama, with first phase of 160 racks, Tier 3 target, and about US$10m investment. Evidence date is checked date because the captured source did not expose an exact publication date.

name: EdgeMode DC Tocumen AI Data Center
notes: Tocumen corridor, Panama City. EdgeMode press release and SEC filing describe DC Tocumen as a planned 1,000 MW AI data center project in Panama under the EdgeMode-BAIF joint venture; Baxtel lists the site as planned for 2028 with expansions through 2036.

name: KIO PAN | 1
notes: Panama Pacific International Business Park, Arraijan. KIO official page gives address and Tier III/career-neutral profile; DCD reports PAN1 commenced operations in 2012 and has around 600 kW capacity; Uptime lists KIO / PA - Fase I certifications.

name: C&W Panama IDC Pacifico / IDC Panama Pacifico Fase II
notes: Panama Pacifico, Arraijan, Panama Oeste. La Estrella reports Uptime Tier III Facility certification for IDC Panama Pacifico Fase II; Uptime lists Cable & Wireless Panama IDC Panama Pacifico Fase II in Arraijan, Panama Oeste with Tier III design and constructed facility certifications.

name: AB Network Primary Data Center / Veracruz Data Center
notes: International Business Park, Panama Pacifico/Howard, Arraijan. AB Network official page states it has its own Tier II data center, 99.741% annual availability, and physical/electrical/cooling capacity for up to 120 physical servers; Uptime lists AB Network Primary Data Center at Panama-Pacifico, Howard.

name: Navegalo Panama Data Center
notes: Antigua Base Howard / Panama Pacifico area. DataCenterMap lists Navegalo Panama Data Center with 1 MW built-out power and 800 sqm whitespace. Aggregator-only confirmation found during search.
